plans.prompt_image: Wide establishing shot of the Kinshasa street corner, blue kiosk on the right, empty wooden stool, minibus taxi passing, vendors walking.
plans.prompt_video: Slow camera push-in, minibus taxi drives from left to right, vendors walking, dust in the golden light.

plans.contenu: Mr. Chen perdu avec sa valise
plans.prompt_image: Medium shot of Mr. Chen pulling his rolling suitcase, looking at his smartphone with a confused expression, street in the background.
plans.prompt_video: Mr. Chen walks slowly, stops, looks at his phone, then looks around, puzzled.

plans.prompt_image: Two-shot, Mr. Chen standing politely in front of Papa Fiston who sits on his stool reading a newspaper by the blue kiosk.
plans.prompt_video: Mr. Chen bows his head slightly and speaks, Papa Fiston lowers his newspaper and looks up.

plans.prompt_image: Medium close-up of Papa Fiston on his stool, big warm smile, arms open.
plans.prompt_video: Papa Fiston opens his arms in a welcoming gesture and talks with a big smile.

repliques.texte: Thank you. I am looking for Zando. Where is Zando market?

plans.prompt_image: Medium close-up of Mr. Chen holding up his phone, hopeful expression.
plans.prompt_video: Mr. Chen talks politely, shows his phone screen, slight nod.

plans.contenu: Papa Fiston montre la mauvaise direction

repliques.texte: Zando? Easy! It is in Limete. Take a bus to Matete. Go straight, then turn right.

plans.prompt_image: Medium shot of Papa Fiston pointing confidently to the right with his whole arm, Mr. Chen following the gesture with his eyes.
plans.prompt_video: Papa Fiston points to the right, then makes a straight gesture and a turning gesture with his hand, very confident.

repliques.texte: Limete... a bus to Matete... OK. Is it far?

plans.prompt_image: Medium close-up of Mr. Chen typing notes on his phone, thoughtful.
plans.prompt_video: Mr. Chen types on his phone, then looks up and asks a question.

repliques.texte: No, no. It is very near. Twenty minutes.

plans.prompt_image: Medium close-up of Papa Fiston waving his hand dismissively, relaxed.
plans.prompt_video: Papa Fiston shakes his head and waves his hand casually, smiling.

plans.prompt_image: Wide shot, Grace walking on the sidewalk towards the kiosk, shoulder bag, Mr. Chen and Papa Fiston on the right.
plans.prompt_video: Grace walks into frame, slows down, stops and turns her head towards the two men.

repliques.texte: Excuse me. Sorry, Papa. That is not correct.

plans.prompt_image: Medium shot of Grace raising one hand politely, kind but firm expression.
plans.prompt_video: Grace raises her hand politely and speaks with a gentle smile.

plans.prompt_image: Close-up of Papa Fiston, eyebrows raised, surprised.
plans.prompt_video: Papa Fiston raises his eyebrows, leans back slightly, surprised.

repliques.texte: Zando is not in Limete. Zando is in Gombe. It is in the city centre.

plans.prompt_image: Medium close-up of Grace turning to Mr. Chen and pointing in the opposite direction.
plans.prompt_video: Grace turns to Mr. Chen and points to the left, explaining calmly.

plans.prompt_image: Medium close-up of Mr. Chen, surprised, adjusting his glasses.
plans.prompt_video: Mr. Chen adjusts his glasses and looks surprised.

repliques.texte: Yes. Gombe. Take a taxi-bus. The driver says "Zando! Zando!". You get in. It is easy.

plans.prompt_image: Medium shot, Grace pointing to a yellow and blue minibus taxi stopping nearby, a conductor leaning out of the door.
plans.prompt_video: A minibus taxi stops, the conductor leans out and waves, Grace points at it and explains.

repliques.texte: It is cheap. Have small money with you.

plans.prompt_image: Two-shot of Mr. Chen and Grace facing each other, Grace showing small banknotes.
plans.prompt_video: Mr. Chen asks, Grace shows a few small banknotes and smiles.

repliques.texte: Ah! Sorry, sorry! Limete is a different market. My mistake!

plans.prompt_image: Medium shot of Papa Fiston laughing and scratching his head.
plans.prompt_video: Papa Fiston bursts out laughing, scratches his head, embarrassed but cheerful.

repliques.texte: No problem. Thank you, sir. And thank you very much, miss.
You're welcome. Come, the bus stop is here. Follow me.

plans.prompt_image: Three-shot of Mr. Chen, Grace and Papa Fiston, everyone smiling.
plans.prompt_video: Mr. Chen bows slightly to both, Grace gestures to follow her.

plans.prompt_image: Wide shot, Grace and Mr. Chen walking away with the suitcase, Mr. Chen waving back, Papa Fiston waving from his stool.
plans.prompt_video: Grace and Mr. Chen walk away towards the minibus taxi, Mr. Chen turns and waves, Papa Fiston waves back.

plans.prompt_image: Medium close-up of Papa Fiston opening his newspaper, amused smile.
plans.prompt_video: Papa Fiston shakes his head with a smile and opens his newspaper again.
